title: acadrust-family screen and peer-reported DWG failure shapes
mode: Broader primary-source codec, lineage, and issue-report review
scope: Screen the current acadrust DWG/DXF codec family as a possible structural comparator.
Reconcile OpenCADStudio and opencadcodec source lineage to avoid counting forks as independent implementations.
Map peer-reported malformed-count, owner-closure, AC1032 auxiliary-object, and AC1027 3DSOLID failure shapes to existing local plan owners.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 explicitly DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

method.kind: Mutable primary project documentation, package manifest, issue reports, and existing plan/source reconciliation
method.evidenceRule: Project declarations and issue reports are candidate-selection/failure-shape evidence only; no peer issue is a local reproduction or semantic support proof. DWG object codes/layouts remain governed by ODA v5.4.1 and local sample traces.

evidence.observed: The project advertises ASCII/binary DXF and DWG read/write through R2018+, SAT/SAB support, and a broad entity/object matrix. Cargo.toml identifies package version 0.6.5 and lists nom, flate2, encoding, and ordinary Rust dependencies without a declared LibreDWG or ACadSharp codec dependency. Project documentation says drawing-dependent tests for absent files are ignored by default.
evidence.limits: Mutable branch/package declarations do not establish the exact source artifact used by downstream applications, complete version/entity coverage, source independence, or real-file test execution. Manifest dependencies are not a full provenance audit.
evidence.planUse: Add as provisional candidate only. Pin version/commit/hash, inspect source and test lineage/license, select an exact direction/version/entity profile, then consider only matched fields with diagnostics and per-record disposition. No install/build is authorized by this screen.

evidence.observed: opencadcodec identifies itself as a fork of hakanaktt/acadrust. OpenCADStudio advertises native DWG/DXF workflows and ACIS tessellation; opencadkernel describes its own ACIS-to-B-rep layer.
evidence.limits: Same-family codec and kernel/application results are not independent votes. App claims and visual/tessellation output are not independent analytic geometry expectations.
evidence.planUse: Treat acadrust/opencadcodec as one codec lineage absent a source-history audit. Any application observation must pin app, codec, kernel, input and output and retain separate parser, shape-validity, and analytic-semantic outcomes.

evidence.observed: The report describes an AC1024 generated bit-flip path where misread array counts may be clamped and zero-filled or a stream-derived allocation may be unbounded; it also mentions a private real DWG. The report identifies acadrust 0.6.3 behavior.
evidence.limits: Not run here; neither the peer issue nor its private DWG proves a libdxfrw failure. Peer code paths and fix status require a pinned source revision.
evidence.planUse: Retain existing fast hardening controls for count-vs-remaining-data bounds, fail-closed truncation, and no plausible zero-padded entities. Add only a missing focused generated negative control.

evidence.observed: The reporter says absent owner block references were re-homed into model space and produced phantom dimension pieces, based on a private corpus comparison with ODA. A maintainer linked a proposed change and asked for retest.
evidence.limits: User/maintainer report only; private corpus and fix retest were not inspected. Does not establish current peer behavior or a local defect.
evidence.planUse: Use as a test-design reminder for existing owner graph closure and orphan dispositions; do not infer membership from aggregate counts or commit the reported corpus.

evidence.observed: The issue reports version-0.6.4 failures in AC1032 MLeader context/associative objects after stricter bounded record parsing, with a maintainer-linked bounded auxiliary-object recovery change.
evidence.limits: No private corpus or broad fix retest was available. It does not justify weakening general record bounds.
evidence.planUse: Keep any optional-object recovery bounded and record-scoped; use existing generated controls and ODA/sample evidence before changing policy.

evidence.observed: The reporter describes a third-party AC1027 modeler-containing drawing rejected with an array-count error at handle 0x5B87 and peer text type_code=37. The report maps that number to the peer's 3DSOLID class and mentions an ASM/ACIS marker, but supplies no independently inspectable drawing artifact in the issue body.
evidence.limits: The peer's internal type_code is not an ODA object type code and cannot be transferred to libdxfrw dispatch. No file, local trace, parser result, or independent semantic result was available.
evidence.planUse: Keep as an unverified AC1027 modeler failure shape only. Require ODA v5.4.1 plus local empirical trace before parser changes; do not guess class codes, download customer data, or promote ACIS semantics.

evidence.observed: Added the acadrust family as provisional, mapped reported failure shapes to existing parser-hardening/owner-closure/auxiliary-record/modeler lanes, and specified self-unblocking behavior when exact peer pins or external files are unavailable.
evidence.limits: No production code, tests, fixtures, or dependencies were changed or run. The review adds no new finding or subplan.
evidence.planUse: Continue local fast-gated implementation under existing owners; use a focused candidate-pin/source-lineage review only if it helps resolve a current matched route.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8 comparator register: acadrust is a provisional candidate; opencadcodec is the same source family unless future provenance work establishes otherwise.
DWG hardening: retain remaining-data count/allocation bounds and fail-closed truncation.
Object graph: preserve explicit owner/orphan dispositions; never synthesize model-space ownership from a missing owner.
AC1032 auxiliary objects: scope recovery to bounded optional records and do not weaken general framing.
AC1027 modeler reads: ODA v5.4.1 and empirical local traces precede any dispatch/layout changes.

validation.scopedDiffCheck: PASS (git diff --check for plan; untracked receipt validated with jq)
